top_choice_rationale: Pd-catalysed C-N cross-coupling is one reaction class made general through mechanism-driven ligand design, worked out independently by Buchwald and Hartwig, confirmed for more than two decades and used daily in discovery and process chemistry. Attribution is the cleanest available, with two independent programmes and no forced exclusions, and a citation worded around general catalytic C-N coupling handles Kosugi's stoichiometric tin precursor and separates it from the 2010 C-C prize. P001 is a strong, original modality, but its three-name allocation omits Ciulli, Sakamoto, Gray, Ito and Kim and joins two strands with different histories; I rank it second, well above no award.
